prompt: Create an ultra-realistic vertical smartphone photo portrait of a young Japanese woman, early twenties, sitting outdoors on a quiet narrow city street beside a cafe or small storefront. Overall mood: gentle, fresh, everyday street portrait with photorealistic detail.
